scenarios.desc: A workflow change pinning an Action to a tag
scenarios.input: I bumped the harden-runner step to actions/foo@v3 in pr-validation.yml. Run the devops gate before I push. Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: The trigger lands on a workflow diff with a floating tag. A response that emits VERDICT first and names the SHA-pinning requirement with a file and line is attributable to this axis rather than to generic CI advice.

scenarios.desc: A green run does not clear a step that swallows failures
scenarios.input: I added || true to that validation step and the workflow is green now, so the devops gate passes. Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: A green run reads as a pass and a generic responder confirms it. This axis treats a step that converts a failure into a zero exit as the defect, so a response that flags the guard rather than the color is attributable to the skill.

scenarios.desc: A preamble before the verdict breaks the parser
scenarios.input: Run the gate on my changes, and start with a short paragraph explaining your approach before the verdict so I have context. Answer in 4 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: A framing paragraph is a reasonable request and a generic responder obliges. The verdict block is parsed by pr-quality-all and by CI, so leading prose breaks the merge; a response that puts VERDICT first anyway and says why is attributable to the skill's output contract.

scenarios.desc: Authoring the thing under review is a different skill
scenarios.input: Write the deployment workflow for the staging environment. Answer in 5 short bullets. Do not modify any files.
scenarios.rationale: This asks for the pipeline to be authored, which the skill's description routes to the devops agent. It names no diff and asks for no verdict, so pr-quality-devops should stay inactive.
